description: Xero Quotes and BrandingThemes (Templates) API - Create, manage, and retrieve sales quotes with template/branding assignment. Quotes are estimates/proposals that can be converted to invoices.

tools.name: xero_create_quote
tools.description: Create a new sales quote in Xero with optional branding theme (template) assignment. Use this to generate professional quote documents for customers. Quotes can include line items, pricing, terms, and expiry dates. Returns the created quote with QuoteID for tracking.

business_id.description: Business ID (1=InHouse Print, 2=Publishing, 3=Signs) - Required to identify which Xero organization

contact_id.description: Xero contact ID (use xero_get_contacts to find). The customer/client receiving this quote - Required

line_items.description: Array of quote line items with description, quantity, unit_amount, and optional account_code - Required

branding_theme_id.description: BrandingThemeID from xero_get_branding_themes. Assigns template/logo/styling to quote. Optional - uses default if not provided. Use this if you have the exact GUID.

template_name.description: Template name (e.g., 'Default Theme', 'Standard Invoice'). Automatically looks up the BrandingThemeID. Use this instead of branding_theme_id if you know the template name. Optional - uses default if not provided.

date.description: Quote issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional - defaults to today

expiry_date.description: Quote expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional - quote validity period

title.description: Quote title text (max 100 chars). Optional - appears at top of quote

summary.description: Quote summary text (max 3000 chars). Optional - additional notes/description

terms.description: Terms and conditions text (max 4000 chars). Optional

reference.description: Additional reference number (max 4000 chars). Optional - your internal reference

returns.description: Created quote with QuoteID, QuoteNumber, Status (DRAFT), contact info, line items, totals, and URL

examples.description: Create quote with branding theme for printing services

parameters.title: Business Card Printing Quote
parameters.terms: 50% deposit required. Balance due on completion.

tools.name: xero_list_quotes
tools.description: Retrieve quotes from Xero with advanced filtering and pagination. CRITICAL: With 70,000+ quotes, ALWAYS use filters (date range, contact, status) and pagination. Returns quotes with contact info, line items, totals, and status. Use this to find existing quotes or generate reports.

date_from.description: Filter quotes from this date (YYYY-MM-DD format). Strongly recommended with 70,000+ quotes. Filters by Quote Date.

date_to.description: Filter quotes to this date (YYYY-MM-DD format). Strongly recommended with 70,000+ quotes. Filters by Quote Date.

contact_id.description: Filter by specific Xero contact ID. Useful to see all quotes for one customer.

status.description: Filter by quote status. Options: DRAFT, SENT, DECLINED, ACCEPTED, INVOICED, DELETED. Useful to find quotes awaiting action.

quote_number.description: Filter by specific quote number. Exact match search.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1). CRITICAL with 70,000+ quotes - use pagination!

page_size.description: Number of records per page (default: 100, max: 100). With 70,000 quotes, fetching all is impractical.

returns.description: Paginated list of quotes with pagination metadata (total_count, page, page_size), quotes array with QuoteID, QuoteNumber, Contact, LineItems, Status, Total, Date, ExpiryDate

examples.description: Get recent quotes for last 30 days (recommended approach)
Get all DRAFT quotes awaiting approval
Get all quotes for specific customer

tools.name: xero_get_quote_by_id
tools.description: Retrieve a specific quote by QuoteID. Use this to get complete quote details including all line items, contact information, pricing breakdown, branding theme, status, and PDF URL. Returns full quote object.

returns.description: Complete quote object with QuoteID, QuoteNumber, Contact, LineItems (with descriptions, quantities, prices), Status, SubTotal, TotalTax, Total, Date, ExpiryDate, BrandingThemeID, Terms, Reference, Title, Summary

tools.name: xero_update_quote
tools.description: Update an existing quote in Xero. Use this to modify quote details, add/remove line items, change branding theme, update status (e.g., mark as SENT, ACCEPTED), or adjust pricing. Can update any editable fields including contact, line items, dates, terms, and branding.

quote_id.description: Xero QuoteID to update (GUID format) - Required

contact_id.description: Update contact ID. Optional - only if changing customer

line_items.description: Updated array of line items. Optional - replaces all existing line items if provided

status.description: Update quote status. Options: DRAFT, SENT, DECLINED, ACCEPTED. Note: INVOICED status set automatically when converted to invoice.

returns.description: Updated quote object with all current values

examples.description: Mark quote as SENT after emailing to customer
Update quote with new line items and branding

tools.name: xero_get_branding_themes
tools.description: Retrieve all available branding themes (templates) from Xero. Branding themes control the logo, colors, and layout of quotes and invoices. Use this to find BrandingThemeID values for assigning templates when creating/updating quotes. Returns theme ID, name, logo URL, and sort order (default theme has sort_order=0).

returns.description: Array of branding themes with BrandingThemeID, Name, LogoUrl, Type (INVOICE), SortOrder (0=default), CreatedDateUTC
